topic: Template Function with Type Traits and Iterator Distance Calculation
explanation: This concept, type traits (specifically 'iterator_traits'), and the 'typename' keyword to deduce and specify the return type based on the iterator's properties. This approach enables writing highly reusable and type-safe code that adapts to different iterator types in the Standard Template Library (STL).
keywords: std::iterator_traits, iterator difference_type, template type deduction, STL generic programming
